question: is there absolutely zero clues from the solves so far, even with our additional metrics?
answer: No — seven quantitative channels, all pointing the same way. The clues are not absent; they are unanimous.

channels.says: all 23 roots are level 1 (rational window, field Q, certificate tier); every one of the 454 beating-grid rows is level 2+ (quadratic fields Q(√2)×323 / Q(√7)×11)
channels.clue: improvements below the rational window exist exactly where a quadratic-or-higher field certificate exists; the roots have none — no tilted construction can ever reach them

channels.says: at target grid−d the best terminal objective gives penetration p ≈ 0.45–0.88 × d, across 3 independent priors, deltas to 1e-5; p → 0 only as d → 0
channels.clue: the engine resolves the boundary to <1.5e-3 (this run's demo) — if a packing existed below grid, some seed would hit ~1e-13 like the pinwheel control does; instead every prior stalls proportionally to the deficit

channels.says: same engine, same seeds, same gate: verified finds with f = 0.00 at every offset above the grid (down to +5e-4); 0 finds with f ~ 2e-6 below it
channels.clue: the 'E ≈ 0.01–0.05' band is not a machinery floor — it is the infeasibility report, and it vanishes above the boundary

channels.says: 23 reject entries touch the roots, every one 'no beat after finalize' at grid+eps
channels.clue: the best-known record itself contains nothing below grid for the roots — the external record and our search agree

channels.says: level-0 (unresolved): 114 rows, improvement_sum 1.630, waste_mean 0.0841; spearman(level, waste) = 0.532
channels.clue: the reachable improvement is concentrated in level-0 (the 114 unresolved rows), not in the roots' level-1 class (whose improvement_sum is −1.1e-10 ≈ 0)

channels.clue: even a perfect crack of the roots is worth 0.03% — the score's real headroom is in level-0 polish
